answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and therefore paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in willow, verified in tide, and thread names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 46 submissions per epoch. A 492 account operation therefore ties up 19 million dollars of idle capital. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
